name: bada-patchguard
description: Bada Reviser PatchGuard — prevents side effects of PHP website rewrites. The original and rewritten trees are kept as tuples in an append-only tuple space, their difference is handled as a patch, successive rewrites are folded into one net patch, and security rules written with the Bada @reviser grammar extension (sink / sanitizer / invariant) gate the patch: ACCEPT / REVIEW / REJECT, with a safe partial patch and a rollback patch. Self-contained HTML app, works offline.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
